failure_classes.missing_api: failure text starts with 'RED: missing API:'; the opt-in carry parameter of a real caller does not exist yet; never counted as verified behaviour
failure_classes.behaviour: any other failure; the real caller behaved differently from the expectation recorded here
failure_classes.missing_wiring: failure text starts with 'RED: missing wiring:'; the API exists but the real gate or merge path does not consume strict required-CI evidence yet; never counted as verified behaviour

opt_in.value: mapping with approved_head, approved_base_sha and repo_root (pathlib.Path of the checkout holding both heads); built only by _carry_opt_in() in the test file, the single adaptation point once Tools publishes the wired names
opt_in.default: absent or None means exact-head behaviour, unchanged
opt_in.published_at: be79431efd4f2c36bfcb333cd97e26b25eb929c4: evaluate_auto_merge_gate(carry_forward=request) with the request fields approved_head, approved_base_sha (assertion), repo_root; merge_with_bridge_receipt publishes no carry opt-in and evaluate_auto_merge_gate refuses carry with apply=True until the semantic receipt consumer exists (intentionally unavailable)

valid_carry_end_to_end.note: approvals only at the approved head; content identical; CI green at the proposed head; queue complete

old_head_objection_under_descriptive_tas.note: recognized RCO objection bound only by the approved head under a descriptive task id (map bypass 3)

shapes.no_pr: payload has only the structured head: invisible to both shared checks at the proposed head today (probe v3 case F)
shapes.with_pr: payload also names the pr: the consensus block scope matches it by PR today (probe v2 case B)

old_head_objection_under_descriptive_tas.reason_published: (?i)block|veto|objection|finding|original head has no valid Rule9a consensus
old_head_objection_under_descriptive_tas.reason_published_note: be79431e refuses in the factory consensus check at the approved head and names the consensus, not the objection; the test also asserts the same carry without the objection is not refused for consensus

snapshot_head_is_the_approved_head.note: stale snapshot: pr_status still names the approved head while the caller expects the proposed head

fresh_apply_after_objection_append.note: objection appended between receipt write and apply; the fresh gate must refuse and gh pr merge must never run

shapes.benign_message: an unrelated ledger message appended between receipt and apply must NOT refuse; the merge runs with --match-head-commit=<proposed head> (Tools 08:00:29Z full-ledger digest concern)

match_head_commit_is_the_proposed_head.note: the merge command carries --match-head-commit=<proposed head> and never the approved head

probe_observations_today.source: exact-head code at main 23564ad4 (identical in this branch), audit probes probe_real_callers_v1..v3
probe_observations_today.consensus_sees_descriptive_task_objectio: verify_bridge_consensus refuses at the exact head it names (cases G, H)
probe_observations_today.rco_check_misses_descriptive_task_object: check_rco_pass_present returns rco_pass_present at the exact head even with a recognized-RCO objection bound to that head under a descriptive task id (cases D, G, H); only matters where bridge consensus is not required
probe_observations_today.old_head_objection_without_pr_invisible_: both shared checks pass at the proposed head (case F): the carry path must scan the approved head explicitly

mutant_runs.M0_no_op: parameter accepted and ignored: the three positive carry tests and the reason-specific refusals fail
mutant_runs.M1_naive_rebind: old-head approvals rebound to the proposed head without content or objection checks: content change, no-pr objection, no-pr late objection and content-change merge tests fail; plan-ready gate still fails on the missing carry record

strict_ci.synthetic_github: FakeGitHub of tests/tools/test_consensus_carry_forward_ci_snapshot.py loaded by path and parameterized with this harness's real git heads; case setups reused from ci_snapshot_cases.json
strict_ci.rollup_isolation: statusCheckRollup stays all-SUCCESS in every strict case, so a refusal can only come from the strict evidence
strict_ci.wiring_expectation: a wired gate refuses unless ci_evidence.all_required_success is true at the expected head; a wired merge path captures strict CI at receipt and again at apply

apply_drift_refuses_merge.drift: bound app unified run turns failed before the apply snapshot

be79_adaptations: every carry gate call passes the synthetic strict GitHub runner (the factory reads the live PR itself; never a live gh call)
original votes carry the reviewed basis (direct route) derived independently from git with the pinned diff command
test checkouts name https://github.com/example/repo.git as origin and the PR change set is the real git path
CI pending and failed at the proposed head are set in the strict check-run inventory, not the rollup
carry record fields are read from the published receipt and its content_identity (names mapped in carry_record_fields_published)
the legit history changes the allowlisted CHANGED_PATH (the carry gate reads the live change set, which must equal git)
old_head_objection reason accepts the published consensus wording, guarded by a no-objection differential
